relationships.subject: Caveolin-1
relationships.evidence_quote: Inhibition of Cav-1 by siRNAs greatly reduced the release of glutamate of ACC, while its overexpression (induced by injecting Lenti-Cav-1) reversed this process.

relationships.subject: ACC glutamatergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: expression of Cav-1 in the ACC was upregulated after intraperitoneal injection of 2 mg/kg clozapine N-oxide

key_findings: Cav-1 is upregulated in ACC glutamatergic neurons of CCI mice and is required for enhanced glutamate release.
Chemogenetic activation of ACC glutamatergic neurons increased glutamate release, shortened paw withdrawal latency and upregulated Cav-1.
